# Final Test Cases: SauceDemo Login

**App under test:** https://www.saucedemo.com/ (public practice site)
**Feature:** Login
**Built from:** 103 raw test cases generated by 4 AI tools (ChatGPT 40, Claude 32, Gemini 16, Copilot 15), merged, de-duplicated and corrected by me.
**Executed on:** [TODO: date] | **Browser:** [TODO: e.g., Chrome 1xx]

## How to read this file

- **Source** shows which AI tool(s) the case came from. "Added by me" means none of the four tools produced it.
- **Expected Result** uses the exact SauceDemo messages where known. Items marked **⚠** are my best prediction and must be confirmed on the live site. The AI tools disagreed on them.
- **Status:** ⬜ Not run | ✅ Pass | ❌ Fail | 👁 Observation (behavior differs from what a real product should do)

**Known messages used below**

| Situation | Message |
|---|---|
| Wrong username or password | `Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service` |
| Username empty | `Epic sadface: Username is required` |
| Password empty | `Epic sadface: Password is required` |
| Locked-out user | `Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.` |
| Inventory opened while logged out | `Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in.` |
